name: Research question
about: Propose or refine a research question or hypothesis
title: "Research question: "
labels: research-question
assignees: ""
---

## Proposed question

State the question in one testable sentence.

## Motivation

What uncertainty in the current protocol would this address?

## Constructs and outcomes

Define the constructs, score direction, and response- or set-level unit.

## Proposed comparison

Describe conditions, controls, and any directional hypothesis.

## Data requirements

Specify synthetic scenario categories, sample implications, and exclusions. Do not paste real reflections or personal data.

## Validity and ethics considerations

List likely confounds, privacy boundaries, and ways the question could be misinterpreted.

## Confirmatory or exploratory?

Explain whether this should be frozen before the main run or labelled exploratory.

## Evidence or references

Link only to verifiable, public sources or repository artefacts. Do not include private product materials.
